mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is >=0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO yoy growth < 0.5%), a month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO yoy growth < 0.5% and INDPRO MOM decline
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO yoy growth < 0.5% and INDPRO declines MOM.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which erodes corporate profit margins and increases real interest rates, predicting negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20d returns is >=0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A spike in the Consumer Price Index above 245 (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 245.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong economy with expanding supply capacity and labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and PAYEMS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS rise > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery (HOUST > 1150), a rising housing starts trend (HOUST) signals increased consumer confidence and spending, predicting positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1150.
